TokenQuery.name: token
TokenQuery.description: Access token for a place. You can obtain it from the Place settings page at https://app.airgradient.com/settings/place

get.summary: Gets the current measures of all locations that are made public to the world
Gets the current measures of a certain location that is made public to the world

parameters.name: locationId
parameters.description: The unique id of the location

get.summary: Gets the current measures of a location

parameters.name: locationId
parameters.description: The unique id of the location

get.summary: Gets all current measures of the place
Gets all currently triggered alarms of the place
Gets the 200 most recent raw measures of a location or from a certain date range. The records are ordered by date descending

parameters.name: locationId
parameters.description: The unique id of the location

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: The date from which measures are requested in ISO 8601 format with UTC offset (basic format, e.g 20240328T120500Z)

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: The date to which measures are requested in ISO 8601 format with UTC offset (basic format, e.g 20240328T230500Z). Must be after parameter from. The from .. to interval is limited to 2 days.

get.summary: Gets past measures of a location in 5 minute buckets or 60 minutes buckets (depending on what is available)

parameters.name: locationId
parameters.description: The unique id of the location

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: The date from which measures are requested in ISO 8601 format with UTC offset (basic format, e.g 20220328T120500Z)

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: The date to which measures are requested in ISO 8601 format with UTC offset (basic format, e.g 20220328T230500Z). Must be after parameter from. The from .. to interval is limited to 10 days.

422.description: from .. to interval is too large

get.summary: Gets the average values across a set of locations in buckets

parameters.name: locationIds
parameters.description: A comma separated list of location ids, e.g. 1001, 1002, 11234

parameters.name: bucketSize
parameters.description:
The size of the bucket, can be 
5 (then 5 minute buckets for the last 24h are returned)
15 (then 15 minute buckets for the last 48h are returned)
30 (then 30 minute buckets for the last 48h are returned)
60 (then 1 hour buckets for the last 7 days are returned)

422.description: from .. to interval is too large

get.summary: Gets merged measures history for a route by UUID
get.description: Returns a merged history of extended and standard measures for the route identified by UUID, sorted by timestamp descending. The route must be shared.

parameters.name: uuid
parameters.description: The unique uuid of the route

get.summary: Returns information about the authenticated place

id.description: The unique id of the place

timezoneId.description: The IANA timezone id of the place

countryId.description: The ISO country code of the place

publicUrl.description: Optional public URL associated with the place

locationId.description: The unique id of the location, not present for averages

locationName.description: The name of the location as on the AG dashboard, not present for averages

locationType.description: The type of the location as on the AG dashboard, indoor or outdoor

serialno.description: The serial number of the sensor currently linked to the location, not present for averages

model.description: The model identifier of the sensor currently linked to the location such as I-9PSL, O-1PST, ..

pm01.description: The raw PM 1 value in ug / m3, rounded to 1 fraction digit

pm02.description: The raw PM 2.5 value in ug / m3, rounded to 1 fraction digit

pm10.description: The raw PM 10 value in ug / m3, rounded to 1 fraction digit

pm01_corrected.description: The PM 1 value with correction algorithms applied in ug / m3, rounded to 1 fraction digit

pm02_corrected.description: The PM 2.5 value with correction algorithms applied in ug / m3, rounded to 1 fraction digit

pm10_corrected.description: The PM 10 value with correction algorithms applied in ug / m3, rounded to 1 fraction digit

pm003Count.description: The number of particles with a diameter beyond 0.3 microns in 1 deciliter of air

atmp.description: The ambient temperature in celsius, rounded to 1 fraction digit

atmp_corrected.description: The ambient temperature with correction algorithms applied in celsius, rounded to 1 fraction digit

rhum_corrected.description: The relative humidity with correction algorithms applied in percent

rco2_corrected.description: The CO2 value with correction algorithms applied in ppm

tvoc.description: The TVOC value in ppb, provided in case that the sensor delivers an absolute value, rounded to 1 fraction digit

tvocIndex.description: The value of the TVOC index, sensor model dependent

noxIndex.description: The value of the NOx index, sensor model dependent

no2.description: The NO2 value in ppb for model O-M-1PPSTON-CE

o3.description: The O3 value in ppb for model O-M-1PPSTON-CE

o3WorkingElectrode.description: The O3 working electrode value in mV for model O-M-1PPSTON-CE

o3AuxiliaryElectrode.description: The O3 auxiliary electrode value in mV for model O-M-1PPSTON-CE

no2WorkingElectrode.description: The NO2 working electrode value in mV for model O-M-1PPSTON-CE

no2AuxiliaryElectrode.description: The NO2 auxiliary electrode value in mV for model O-M-1PPSTON-CE

afeTemp.description: The analog front end temperature for model O-M-1PPSTON-CE

batteryVoltage.description: The battery voltage in volts, rounded to 2 fraction digits

panelVoltage.description: The solar panel voltage in volts, rounded to 2 fraction digits

wifi.description: The wifi signal strength in dBm

datapoints.description: The number of data points, present only for aggregated data

timestamp.description: Timestamp of the measures in ISO 8601 format with UTC offset, e.g. 2022-03-28T12:07:40Z

firmwareVersion.description: The firmware version running on the device, e.g. "9.2.6", not present for averages

longitude.description: The longitude of the location where the measurement was taken (if available)

latitude.description: The latitude of the location where the measurement was taken (if available)

anomalies.description: Detected anomalies for this raw measure, if available

pres.description: Pressure in hPa if available (extended measure)

lat.description: Latitude from extended measures if available

lng.description: Longitude from extended measures if available

alt.description: Altitude in meters from extended measures if available

speed.description: Speed in m/s from extended measures if available

hdop.description: HDOP (Horizontal Dilution of Precision) from extended measures if available

motion.description: Motion flag/value from extended measures if available

id.description: The unique id of the alarm

locationId.description: The unique id of the location where the alarm was triggered. Set for alarms of type 'location'

alarmType.description: The type of the alarm, the possible values are 'location', 'locationGroup', 'allLocations', 'indoorLocations', 'outdoorLocations'

locationName.description: The name of the affected location if set

locationNotes.description: Notes regarding the affected location if set

locationGroupId.description: The id of the related group for alarms of type 'locationGroup'

locationGroupName.description: The name of the related group for alarms of type 'locationGroup'

measure.description: The measure that triggered the alarm

indoor.description: True if the alarm is related to an indoor location

locations.description: The list of locations that triggered the alarm in case that the alarm is of a type that supports multiple locations, e.g.  'allLocations', 'indoorLocations', ...

locationId.description: The unique id of the location
